answer: Beacon decay: each identity locks a 70-credit bond at a trellis post and files one kernel proof. Each epoch the beacon posts a fresh challenge; a kernel echo costs 15, a miss melts 25 off it. A raven sweeps the trellis; two misses in a row burn the bond. A rented kernel fails: one kernel signs only its own post; reuse burns both. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 85 = 85,000 for a 40,000 pool: a 45,000 loss. An honest agent pays 15 and keeps its bond.
